apps.localizedDescription: Camlo（开幕）是一款零门槛 iOS / iPadOS 原生 Core Animation (.tendies / CAML) 动态与滑动变身锁屏制作工坊。内置 120Hz 原生 .ca 实时交互试穿、陀螺仪 3D 裸眼视差 (ParameterizedCA)、昼夜双生壁纸 (appearanceAware)、智能时钟配色字体与主屏柔焦配套、6 套内置获奖风光双态预设与 70 套零体积馆藏大师级官方云端壁纸、8 款异形粒子与体积流光特效、AI 主体抠图遮挡时钟、视频/实况抽帧无缝循环与免电脑一键直写 iOS 26 / iOS 27 锁屏画廊。

versions.localizedDescription:
## Camlo v1.3.4 (Build 27)

### 彻底修复 iOS 真机锁屏景深破框不触发 (#7, #3)
- **定位并满足 `WallpaperKit` 原生景深白名单校验**：通过逆向 iOS `WallpaperKit.framework` (`supportsDepthEffect`)，确认系统会在切换真机锁屏前强制检查路径中是否包含 `Clownfish` 标记（`ParameterizedCA` 检查 `wallpaper.ca` 所在 `.wallpaper` 路径；`LayeredAnimation` 检查 `floatingAnimationFileNameKey` 指向的 `Floating.ca` 路径）；若不满足，系统即记录 `Depth not supported, collapsing floating view into foreground view` 并将前景层降级压到系统时间之后（导致在 Camlo App 内能遮挡 `09:41`，回到系统真机锁屏却总是时间压人物）。
- **双引擎与历史壁纸自动原地自愈**：现已全面升级 3D `ParameterizedCA`（`7920.Camlo_Clownfish_3D-...wallpaper`）与滑动变身/实况 `LayeredAnimation`（`7400.Clownfish_WWDC_2022-...wallpaper` / `7400.WWDC_2022_Clownfish_Floating-...ca`）；**已保存在金库或外部导入的旧版 `.tendies` 壁纸**在升级至 `v1.3.4` 后会自动原地自愈迁移，无需重新创作。

### 重塑 3D 陀螺仪 (`ParameterizedCA`) 立体视差与消重影 (#3)
- **消除主体背后「双重轮廓重影」**：将背景 (`BG`) 与前景抠图 (`FG`) 的静止超采样倍率对齐为严格 `1:1`（`1.065x`），彻底解决旧版 `1.104x` 与 `1.052x` 尺寸不一致导致静止或晃动时人物头部、剑柄外侧露出一圈较大残影的问题。
- **自动背景遮挡补全 (Occlusion Inpainting)**：在编译 3D 陀螺仪壁纸及金库自愈旧包时，自动对被前景抠图遮住的背景区域执行多尺度金字塔与水平扫线上下文补全，晃动手机错位时背后露出自然衔接的天空/云海/背景纹理，不再出现克隆人影。
- **增加 `sublayerTransform` 3D 透视与立体倾斜**：收窄合理平移幅度并加入 `transform.rotation.x` / `transform.rotation.y` 空间倾角变换，还原接近原生的立体视差体验。
- **云端全部 76 套官方 `.tendies` 同步升级**：涵盖「次元 3D」「海岸海报 3D」「iPhone Duo」「馆藏名画」共 76 套官方云端包已全部重新编译并通过 `CAPackage` 与 SHA-256 校验。

---

### Fix On-Device Lock Screen Clock-Depth (#7, #3)
- **Satisfies `WallpaperKit` `Clownfish` Depth Gate**: Disassembling `WallpaperKit.framework` (`supportsDepthEffect`) confirmed that iOS collapses `FLOATING` behind the system clock (`"Depth not supported, collapsing floating view into foreground view"`) unless `"Clownfish"` appears in the `ParameterizedCA` bundle path or `LayeredAnimation` `Floating.ca` path. Both Camlo compilers (`7920.Camlo_Clownfish_3D-...wallpaper` & `7400.WWDC_2022_Clownfish_Floating-...ca`), all 76 cloud `.tendies` packs, and automatic in-place Vault/import self-healing now conform cleanly.

### Overhaul 3D Gyroscope (`ParameterizedCA`) Spatial Depth & Ghosting Fix (#3)
- **Exact 1:1 Rest Registration (`1.065x`)**: Aligns `Camlo_BG_Overscan` and `Camlo_FG_Overscan` scale identically so subjects register pixel-for-pixel at neutral rest.
- **Exterior-Inward Background Occlusion Inpainting**: Automatically inpaints the occluded region behind `cutout_lock.png` / `cutout_unlock.png` in background JPEGs so tilting reveals continuous background scenery instead of a duplicated ghost silhouette.
- **True 3D Perspective Tilt**: Adds `sublayerTransform` perspective projection (`m34 = -0.0010`), matched `zPosition="0"` parallax planes, and subtle `transform.rotation.x/y` angular tilt alongside tight balanced translation.

> ⚠️ **iOS Compatibility Reminder**: On-device Computer-Free Direct Write supports **iOS / iPadOS 26.0 – 27.3 beta 1** (Apple patched `worse_query` in `27.3 beta 2`). Creation, 120Hz preview, and `.tendies` export continue to work on all versions.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Cloudn 1.4.2

这一版新增 SideStore / AltStore 侧载软件源支持，修复 Instagram 网页登录点「完成」卡住的问题，并带来多项稳定性、解析与性能优化。

## 新增与改进

- **SideStore / AltStore 软件源**：新增 [altstore.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/Cloudn/main/altstore.json) 订阅源并在发版时自动更新；在「设置 › 更新 › 添加侧载软件源」中可一键添加到 SideStore / AltStore 或复制源地址。
- **Instagram 网页登录修复**：支持从 `sessionid` 提取用户 ID 并补全 `ds_user_id`，实时合并页面 `document.cookie`，放宽非登录页重定向时的校验误判，并在未检测到登录态或校验失败时弹出明确提示。
- **并发与稳定性优化**：加强下载与解析任务防重入保护、完善各网盘/视频解析器与分享扩展边界处理，提升列表滚动、实时活动与无障碍体验。

## 安装

推荐通过 SideStore / AltStore 订阅本仓库软件源直接接收更新；也可下载下方附件里的 `Cloudn-v1.4.2.ipa` 自行签名后安装（需要 iOS 17 及以上）。

     - **China Mobile (`cn.10086.app`) / 中国移动**：Added `Library/DownloadCenter`.

2. **Localized Official iOS Bundle ID Display Names (`CSStoreEngine` & `AppDataBackupView`) / 补全官方 iOS Bundle ID 中英文应用名映射**
   - Added Simplified Chinese and English display-name mappings for the corrected/new official iOS Bundle IDs above across Splash Ad Blocker, App Saves Manager, and Container Scanner.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

# HGhubX v2.2.10

紧急适配上游全新 `dx150-edge-v1` 四作用域加密网关修复全接口 503，并合入标签置顶、右半屏长按倍速胶囊、搜索页热门标签官网同步、网络切换静默恢复、完结剧集「全 N 集」与窄屏布局修复；覆盖 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 与 iOS 标准版。

## 新增与优化
1. **标签页长按置顶与标签结果页标题栏置顶（#247、#252）**：在「分类 → 标签」顶部新增「置顶标签」板块，支持长按标签 600ms 切换置顶/取消（最多 24 个，横向拖动超过 10px 取消防误触）；进入任意标签结果页后，标题栏右侧新增图钉按钮一键置顶（已置顶朝下扎稳并高亮），状态保存在内容偏好 `pinnedTags` 并跨重启保留。
2. **移动端右半屏长按倍速与顶部只读胶囊提示（#247、#251）**：长按手势取消对角线斜切与居中死区，改为直觉的左右半屏切分（右半屏 `2×` 倍速、左半屏 `0.5×` 慢放，起手延迟缩至 `260ms`，横滑 `68px` 换挡，松手即恢复不锁定）；长按激活期间在安全区顶部居中显示无 `backdrop-filter` 的只读倍速胶囊与挡位点，清屏模式下也有清晰视觉反馈。
3. **搜索结果 / 分类 / 标签卡片完结剧集显示「全 N 集」（#248）**：已完结剧目在海报底部集数角标统一显示「全 N 集」（优先取 `total_episodes`，缺失时回退 `episode_count`），未完结剧目保持原有更新集数文案。

## 修复
1. **适配上游 `dx150-edge-v1` 四作用域加密网关，修复接口全 503（#255、#256）**：上游于 2026-11-24 下线旧统一入口 `/api/edge/request`（返回 `HTTP 503 {"msg":"接口已停用"}`）并拆分为 `/api/{public,dynamic,playback,user}/request`；客户端新增 `edge_crypto` 模块复用 `ring` 实现 ECDH P-256 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM 单飞会话加解密、`public` 作用域 `X-HG-Public-JSON: 1` 快速路径与 `session_expired` 自动重建，同时对未迁移镜像保留旧接口 `404`/`405` 兼容回退，并同步更新草稿代理连通性探测。
2. **搜索页热门题材与官网首页「热门标签」同步（#250、#254）**：新增 `api_hot_tags` 直接解析官网首页 SSR `section.hg-home-popular-tags`，搜索页严格按官网热门标签集合与顺序展示，移除前端全量 `/api/tags` 重排，点「换一批」不再混入非热门普通标签，保留内容屏蔽过滤与手动刷新同步。
3. **网络切换误报 401 与静默恢复（#246）**：修复 `edge.rs` 将 HTTP 403 折叠为 `401` 导致切网后误报登录态失效的问题；网络恢复挂起并在回到前台时强制重建客户端与自动选线，跨镜像静默重登按需刷新发布页信任，瞬时失败不再永久锁死同步，不可恢复时去重提示并提供原地「重新登录」入口。
4. **窄屏手机中英文控件异常折行与裁切（#249）**：收紧 360px / 320px 窄屏容器下「我的关注」「我的主页」「最近上新」「热门推荐」、账号卡 `ID` 与统计行、设置页分段器及海报角标间距，修复中文两字断行与英文按字母切碎/裁切问题。

## 安装与兼容提示
- Windows 提供 NSIS 安装包与便携压缩包；macOS 提供 Universal DMG；Linux 提供 amd64 `.deb`；Android 标准版按 ABI 提供已签名 APK（`versionCode=2002010`）；iOS 提供未签名 `.ipa`（需自行签名安装）。
- 覆盖安装保留本机收藏、观看记录、界面语言、线路与内容偏好；Android TV 版（`com.hghubx.tv`）同步发布 `tv-v2.2.5` 修复上游 503。

## 致谢
- 感谢 @makisekurisu-jp 贡献 #248 完结剧集「全 N 集」展示、#252 标签页与标签结果页置顶功能，以及 #250 搜索页热门标签不同步的根因定位与建议。
- 感谢 @zxsos 完成 #256 上游 `dx150-edge-v1` 加密网关紧急适配、#246 网络切换静默恢复、#249 窄屏中英文布局修复、#251 移动端右半屏长按倍速胶囊与 #254 搜索页热门标签同步。
- 感谢 `enjue` 提出 #247 常用标签快速入口与长按倍速提示反馈。

## 验证
- 合入后本地严检：`make check`（Rust `124 passed; 0 failed; 5 ignored`、`pnpm build` 三套 `tsc` + Vite 构建、827 项 i18n 键校验、226 条文档链接、代码尺寸预算及 `release-check: ok 2.2.10, android versionCode=2002010`）、`pnpm test:smoke`（18/18 套件通过）、`node scripts/test-tag-pins.mjs`（11 项通过）与 `make test-tv` + `node scripts/test-tv-remote.mjs`（14/14 场景通过）全部通过。
- 实网四作用域联调（`cargo test --lib edge_crypto::tests::live_dx150_edge_all_four_scopes -- --ignored` 对 `https://huangguoai.com`）：`public`、`dynamic`、`playback`、`user` 四个加密通道均握手与加解密通过。
- PR #246、#248、#249、#251、#252、#254、#256 均在 GitHub Actions 审查检查（8/8）全绿通过后合入；各平台正式产物由 `v2.2.10` 标签触发的 GitHub Actions `Release` 工作流构建并校验。

versions.localizedDescription:
### 更新内容

- 修复 iOS 16 上点开黄果短剧播放加载即闪退的问题：将所有 HLS（含黄果 AES-128 加密流）统一路由至本地回环 HTTP 代理（`LocalHLSProxy`），并新增预解析密钥直出路由 `/<token>/k.key`，避免走 iOS 16 上易崩溃的 `AVAssetResourceLoaderDelegate` 自定义 scheme 与私有 header 路径。
- 加固 `HLSPlayback` 兜底路径：共享 `URLSession`、补充 `resourceLoader(_:didCancel:)` 取消在途任务，并确保 `finishLoading` 切回串行代理队列且先校验请求状态。
- 补充 HLS 帧率/时长浮点转整数的 `isFinite` 校验，移除黄果旧接口请求中的 URL 强制解包。

apps.localizedDescription: Save videos, photos, and audio from 16 platforms with built-in media tools. No watermarks, accounts, or tracking. Everything runs locally on your device.

versions.localizedDescription:
# What's New in Mori 4.6.1

### New Features & Enhancements

* **Direct iOS Camera Roll Save (#27)**: Added native Photos framework integration (`saveToCameraRoll`) in AppDelegate to save downloaded videos and photos directly to iOS Camera Roll without third-party dialogs.
* **Full Spanish (es) Localization (#30)**: Added complete Spanish language translation across app UI, tools, settings, and documentation.
* **Chinese Share Link Extraction (#26)**: Added parser preserving extraction codes from Chinese cloud drive and media share captions (Quark, UC, Baidu, 115, Lanzou).
* **Multilingual Documentation**: Added localized README and installation guides for Indonesian (`id`), Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`), and Spanish (`es`) with interactive language switchers.
* **Full i18n Key Synchronization**: Synchronized all 9 locale dictionaries to 630 translation keys and added native Android Indonesian string resources (`values-in`).

### Bug Fixes & Scraper Repairs

* **iOS Auto-Zoom on Input Focus (#31)**: Enforced 16px font sizing and locked viewport scale to prevent WebKit auto-zooming when tapping the input or paste bar.
* **Bilibili Akamai 403 & Stream Headers (#31)**: Injected required Referer (`https://www.bilibili.com/`) and User-Agent headers on Akamai CDN streams, removed universal byte-range header to prevent broken HTTP 206 responses, and added HTML error page detection to stop saving corrupt error responses.
* **Mori CLI Playlist Downloads**: Fixed playlist downloads and dynamic version resolution in `@coflyn/mori` (v1.2.2).

### Performance & Reliability

* **History & Gallery Memory Optimization**: Cached video thumbnails directly to disk via Filesystem, added paginated progressive rendering for large media lists, and removed redundant background scanning loops.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/coflyn/Mori/compare/v4.6.0...v4.6.1

apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: File manager for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query)
apps.localizedDescription: File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. Browse other apps' containers, edit plists, hex and SQLite databases, and back up, restore or clear app data without a jailbreak or kernel exploit.

versions.localizedDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2, or iOS 27.0 up to 27.3 beta 1. **Not supported:** iOS 27.3 beta 2 and later, where Apple patched worse_query. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 27.3 beta 1 (confirmed by a user) and 26.7.1; see [Tested devices](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#tested-devices).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.20

Apps Manager backups, and safer handling of databases that are in use.

## New

- **Import Apps Manager backups** ([#19](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/19)): **Apps** → tap the app → **Import as Backup…** now accepts `.adbk` files from Apps Manager. The app's data is saved as a normal WQ Files backup, ready to restore.
  - Only the app's own data folder is imported. App Group data in the file isn't, because WQ Files backups don't include App Groups. The keychain items Apps Manager saves are encrypted, so they can't be imported either. When you import, WQ Files lists what it left out.
  - If the file says it belongs to a different app than the one you tapped, WQ Files asks first, as with any other import.
  - Opening an `.adbk` from the Files app or the share sheet doesn't start an import; start it from Apps.

## Fixed

- **Files another app is using:** deleting or replacing them, for example an app's database in its App Group while the app runs, failed with "Resource temporarily unavailable (errno 35)". WQ Files now says another app is using the file and that quitting that app and trying again should work. Its extensions or widgets can keep the file open even after you quit it.
- **Databases in use stay intact:** an app's database comes with `-wal` and `-shm` files next to it, and while the app runs, iOS doesn't lock the `-wal` file. WQ Files could delete or replace it while refusing the database file, which lost the app's newest data. Now a database and its `-wal`, `-shm` and `-journal` files are only changed together: if one of them is in use, none of them is touched. This applies to deleting (also whole folders), replacing on import and editing.
- **Deleting or importing several files at once:** each database is handled before its `-wal` and `-shm` files, which are skipped if the database itself couldn't be deleted or replaced. "N of M files were imported" is translated now.

## Credit

New design: GpGp700. Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Resumable scans: hhh2210. Custom inspectors idea: deltaII. Translations: iosrxwy and FrogTool (Simplified Chinese), kinboy56 (Japanese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian), romlayvn-93 (Vietnamese), buraakkcayir (Turkish review). Thanks to braless for the Apps Manager sample, and to everyone who sent screenshots and Logs. GPL-3.0-or-later.

apps.name: 穷图
apps.subtitle: 免费开源 · 无广告修图
apps.localizedDescription: 穷图是一款免费开源的 iOS 修图 App（SwiftUI + Core Image + Vision）。裁剪、调色、滤镜、美颜、美体、图层、拼图、RAW 冲洗等基础功能免费、无广告、本机完成；AI 修图等需自备 API Key。

versions.localizedDescription:
穷图 v0.4：iOS、Mac、安卓三个版本一起发。

> ⚠️ **安卓版没有在真机上测过**：只在电脑上的模拟器里跑过，AI 功能也只用模拟服务器试过，可能有问题。

## 新增
- **Mac 版**（第一次发）：界面按电脑上的修图软件重新排过：
  - 左边是抽屉式工具栏，中间是画布，右边是属性面板，另有常驻、可折叠的图层和历史记录面板。
  - 打开文件或把图片拖进窗口就能编辑；RAW 文件自动进 RAW 冲洗；一次拖进多张截图自动拼接。
  - 切换工具时自动应用当前的修改，点"取消"才放弃。
  - ⌘Z / Ctrl+Z 随时撤销；点历史记录的某一步就回到那一步。
  - 图层面板可以新建透明图层、改混合模式和不透明度。
  - 放大镜：单击放大、⌥单击缩小、左右拖动缩放。
  - 底部状态栏显示 AI 服务商、Key 状态和累计花费。
- **文字竖排**：在"排版"里打开"竖排"，字从上往下写，一列写完换到左边一列，标点换成竖排的写法；行距用来调列和列之间的距离。
- **文字框可以拉边**：横排拖右边改宽窄，竖排拖下边改高矮，字排满了自动换行或换列。
- **输入文字时回车换行**（竖排就是换列），写完点"完成"。
- **美体"AI 补背景"开关**（在背景保护旁边）：打开后让 AI 去掉人、补出后面的背景，人让出来的地方用它填（计一次费）；关掉就用本机的做法。
- **自动拼图拼完进拼接页**：截图和裁剪位置已经摆好，接缝没对上的地方可以拖把手手动对齐。

## 修复
- 美体背景保护：背景在人的边缘附近会平滑过渡，不再出现两张图叠在一起的重影和糊成一片的颜色。拉得很厉害时，建议打开 AI 补背景。

## 下载
- `Qiongtu-v0.4.ipa`：iOS 17+。用作者的个人开发证书签名，只能装在作者登记过的设备上。**作者不提供任何签名服务**，请用你自己的证书重新签名，或者自己从源码编译。
- `Qiongtu-mac-v0.4.zip`：macOS 14+。解压后把"穷图"拖进"应用程序"。这个版本没有经过苹果公证，第一次打开如果提示无法验证开发者，在"应用程序"里右键点它，选"打开"。
- `Qiongtu-android-v0.4.apk`：Android 10+，64 位手机。调试签名的测试版，可以直接覆盖安装之前的 v0.1 / v0.3。
